## ✅ Checklist
<!-- Mark completed items with an "x" -->

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added error handling where appropriate

### Testing
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have checked that my changes don't break existing functionality

### Documentation
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] I have updated the README if necessary
- [ ] I have added inline code comments where necessary

### Security & Performance
- [ ] I have checked for potential security vulnerabilities
- [ ] I have considered the performance impact of my changes
- [ ] I have followed security best practices

### Dependencies
- [ ] I have updated package versions if necessary
- [ ] I have checked for dependency conflicts
- [ ] I have updated lock files if dependencies changed

## 🔍 Code Review Checklist (for reviewers)
- [ ] Code follows project conventions
- [ ] Changes are well tested
- [ ] Security considerations have been addressed
- [ ] Performance impact is acceptable
- [ ] Documentation is adequate
- [ ] Breaking changes are properly documented
